changes.name: Furor
changes.before: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain 100% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of 100 Energy.
changes.after:
Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 100% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy per sec spent outside Cat Form, up to 100 Energy.

Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.

changes.name: Natural Instinct
changes.before: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.

changes.name: Expose Prey
changes.before: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.
changes.after: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.

changes.name: Reckoning
changes.before: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.
changes.after: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike. Cannot occur more often than once every 1.5 sec.

changes.name: Penance
changes.before: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 81 Holy damage to an enemy, or 184 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
changes.after: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 42 Holy damage to an enemy, or 126 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

changes.name: Demonic Brand
changes.before: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target generate high threat and deal $<minDam> to $<maxDam> Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.
changes.after: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal $<minDam> to $<maxDam> Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

changes.name: Anticipation
changes.before: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.
changes.after: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

changes.name: Bastion
changes.before: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.
changes.after: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.

changes.name: Blood Craze
changes.before: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.
changes.after: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

changes.name: Bloodthirst
changes.before: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
changes.after: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

changes.name: Booming Voice
changes.before: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.
changes.after: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

changes.name: Dual Wield Specialization
changes.before: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25% and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.

changes.name: Flurry
changes.before: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
changes.after: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

changes.name: Focused Rage
changes.before: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.
changes.after: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.

changes.name: Furious Precision
changes.before: Increases your maximum Rage by 30.
changes.after: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

changes.name: Gore Drinker
changes.after: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

changes.name: Impale
changes.before: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

changes.name: Improved Berserker Rage
changes.before: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.
changes.after: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

changes.name: Improved Bloodrage
changes.before: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.
changes.after: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

changes.name: Improved Cleave
changes.before: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 3.

changes.name: Improved Disarm
changes.before: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.
changes.after: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by 20 secs.

changes.name: Improved Revenge
changes.before: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.
changes.after: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.

changes.name: Improved Shield Bash
changes.before: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.
changes.after: Gives your Shield Bash ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 3 sec.

changes.name: Improved Slam
changes.before: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.
changes.after: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.

changes.name: Iron Will
changes.after: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

changes.name: Last Stand
changes.before: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.
changes.after: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

changes.name: Lingering Rage
changes.before: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.
changes.after: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

changes.name: Piercing Howl
changes.before: Causes all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
changes.after: Causes all enemies within 0 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

changes.name: Precision
changes.before: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

changes.name: Raging Blows
changes.before: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your Off Hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.
changes.after: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

changes.name: Spearing Strike
changes.before: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.
changes.after: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

changes.name: Toughness
changes.before: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

changes.name: Unbridled Wrath
changes.before: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.
changes.after: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

changes.name: Vanguard
changes.before: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.
changes.after: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.
